step1_analysis.description: A receiver pre-amplifier for a pulsed signaling transceiver. It features multiple input branches and diode-connected active loads to achieve high bandwidth for AC-coupled bus communication.

paper_reference.title: A 5.6-mW 1-Gb/s/pair Pulsed Signaling Transceiver for a Fully AC Coupled Bus

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the pre-amplifier.

paper_reported.technology: Not specified (likely 0.18um or 0.13um based on year)

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a tail current of ~1.5mA from the bias network at 1.8V supply, Power = 1.8V * 1.5mA = 2.7mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported power consumption for the receiver pre-amplifier, scaled to SKY130 1.8V nominal VDD.

ac_gain.description: Low-frequency or mid-band voltage gain of the pre-amplifier.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly stated (typically 10-20 dB for pre-amps)

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain ~ gm * Rout. With diode-connected loads, Rout is ~1/gm_load. Gain is roughly gm_in / gm_load.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Diode-connected loads limit the maximum gain but extend the bandwidth, typical for high-speed pre-amplifiers.

bandwidth_3db.description: The frequency at which the AC gain drops by 3 dB from its maximum value.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cout). Low Rout from diode-connected loads pushes the pole to higher frequencies.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports a 3.2 GHz corner frequency for the bus topology; the pre-amplifier must support at least this bandwidth.

transient_vpp.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage swing for a given input signal.

sky130_expected.calculation: For a 200mVpp input and a gain of ~4 V/V (12 dB), expected output swing is ~800mVpp, limited by headroom.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ensures the pre-amplifier can drive the subsequent latch or decision circuit effectively.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, 3dB bandwidth, and transient output swing of the receiver pre-amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Receiver Pre-amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VN5 N5 0 0.9
VN4 N4 0 0.9
VN7 N7 0 0.9
VN6 N6 0 0.9 ac 1 sin(0.9 0.1 500MEG)

* DUT
XM1 N1 N1 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N1 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N3 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 N6 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N3 N5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N0 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N1 N7 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N1 LABEL_NET_0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}

.control
* DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(N1)

* AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 50 1Meg 10G
let gain_db = vdb(N1)
meas ac max_gain max gain_db
let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

* Transient Analysis for Output Swing
tran 10p 10n
meas tran v_max max v(N1)
meas tran v_min min v(N1)
meas tran v_pp param='v_max - v_min'

quit
.endc
